positions.name: BranchLibraryTuesdayThursdayHoursAndStaffing
positions.frame: Given when commuters bring books back and what the staffing can cover, how should the branch library's Tuesday and Thursday hours be set?
positions.why: Both statements describe one Tuesday/Thursday schedule: an eight o'clock opening aimed at commuter returns, and an hour-earlier close to keep staffing flat. The opening serves borrowers, and the closing is a staffing trade-off. The two sit together as a cost-and-benefit pairing under a single question about setting the hours. The existing winter-rota position concerns a volunteer tool library's Saturday-only opening and a second Saturday volunteer, which is a different venue and a different decision, so I mint rather than attach.
